say:2:1041310001:1.text: I've been thinking about the past recently... All those years ago, our youth are just memories to us old-timers now.
say:2:1041310001:1.source_cn: 最近我总会想起过去的事情……那些岁月呦，都已经变成我们...

say:3:1041310002:1.text: Eomir is also a memory now. Although it can't be called a good memory, he did once protect the Dark Forest when we were younger.
say:3:1041310002:1.source_cn: 伊米尔……也是回忆了。虽然称不上是美好的回忆，但他终究...

choice_prompt:4:1041310002.text: Eomir is also a memory now. Although it can't be called a good memory, he did once protect the Dark Forest when we were younger.
choice_prompt:4:1041310002.source_cn: 伊米尔……也是回忆了。虽然称不上是美好的回忆，但他终究曾是薄暮丛林的守护者。

say:5:1041310003:1.text: We're still restless youngsters then, just like Lyca and Eironn now.
say:5:1041310003:1.source_cn: 那时候我们都还是毛毛躁躁的年轻人，就跟莱卡、埃隆他们现...

say:6:1041310004:1.text: Arden has always been the perplexing goody two-hooves that he is. I was a fiery vixen with a short temper, and Eomir was the stubborn one out of us three.
say:6:1041310004:1.source_cn: 雅顿从来都是一副神神秘秘的好人模样，我有副急脾气，伊米...

say:7:1041310005:1.text: The three of us didn't always see eye to eye, but our goals were the same.
say:7:1041310005:1.source_cn: 我们三人的意见并非总是一致，但目的却完全相同。

say:8:1041310006:1.text: I remember once that Eomir led the Thorned Guards against invaders of the Dark Forest. They fought for five days straight.
say:8:1041310006:1.source_cn: 我记得有一次，他曾带着荆棘卫队同入侵丛林的敌人战斗了五...

say:9:1041310007:1.text: That exhausted but determined look on his face will forever be imprinted in my mind.
say:9:1041310007:1.source_cn: 那副疲惫却坚定的样子，到现在还清晰地印在我的脑海里。

say:10:1041310008:1.text: Over the years, I have had many quarrels with Eomir, but he is indeed a sage and an elder of the Dark Forest... or at least he was.
say:10:1041310008:1.source_cn: 这么些年来，我没少和伊米尔吵架争执，但他确实是名副其实...

choice_prompt:11:1041310008.text: Over the years, I have had many quarrels with Eomir, but he is indeed a sage and an elder of the Dark Forest... or at least he was.
choice_prompt:11:1041310008.source_cn: 这么些年来，我没少和伊米尔吵架争执，但他确实是名副其实的“贤者”……至少曾经是。

say:12:1041310009:1.text: Yes, but why? The two of us have been thinking about this issue.
say:12:1041310009:1.source_cn: 是啊，为什么呢？我们两个老家伙也一直在想这个问题。

choice_prompt:13:1041310009.text: Yes, but why? The two of us have been thinking about this issue.
choice_prompt:13:1041310009.source_cn: 是啊，为什么呢？我们两个老家伙也一直在想这个问题。

say:14:1041310010:1.text: Perhaps... He may have been dissatisfied with all his power and his inability to leave any lasting achievements in this world.
say:14:1041310010:1.source_cn: 或许他不甘心自己手握重权却无法做出惊天动地的功绩——

say:15:1041310011:1.text: Our lives were so peaceful... So peaceful that the legendary Three Sages of the Dark Forest lived ordinary, peaceful lives as ordinary folks.
say:15:1041310011:1.source_cn: 因为我们的生活太过安宁，安宁到曾经的“三贤者”都过得像...

say:16:1041310012:1.text: Or perhaps it's because we were getting older. Our wrinkles, gray hair, and stiff joints... None of us were spared that. Even Dahnie's voice isn't as loud as it was before.
say:16:1041310012:1.source_cn: 也或许因为我们年岁渐长。皱纹、白发，不再灵活的腿脚，哪...

say:17:1041310013:1.text: Or maybe he was afraid that his old ambitions would turn to dust. Aging is the will of nature. Only the gods are eternal.
say:17:1041310013:1.source_cn: 也许他害怕自己的雄心壮志空化为埃蠹。可衰老是自然的意志...

say:18:1041310014:1.text: Hmph! Our bodies may have aged, but he let his heart wither!
say:18:1041310014:1.source_cn: 哼，我们衰老的是身体，他却连心也跟着衰老了。

choice:11:0:1.text: He became a danger to the forest.
choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 但他变成了危害丛林的人
choice:11:0:1.male: He became a danger to the forest.
choice:11:0:1.female: He became a danger to the forest.

choice:4:0:1.source_cn: 当年你们和他关系很好？
